eligibility: Explicit domestic satire brief with a speech-supported claim/action contrast; a household noun alone is insufficient.
seriesRule: Adjacent images require the same declared series, different supported actions/assets and exact disjoint retained-word evidence.
speakerRule: Keep the opening claim and final spoken payoff on the presenter. A short illustrative setup may precede the payoff, returning before its words.
motion: Motivated shot changes and brief entries; no random zooms or effect cadence.
fallback: Keep the presenter when genre, contrast, action specificity, rights, timing or ready matching assets are missing. AI/technical explainers use their own visual grammar.
